summary: The United States launched a new wave of airstrikes against Iran, with explosions reported in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Shiraz, and Kermanshah. US President Trump threatened to strike Iranian power plants and bridges next week if no agreement is reached. Israel and Hezbollah remain on heightened alert along the Lebanon front.
key_points: The US military announced a new wave of attacks on Iran with blasts reported in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, and Shiraz (Source: @New_security8200/202628).
Four locations around the southwestern city of Ahvaz came under US airstrikes (Source: @presstv/198902).
Trump threatened to strike Iranian power plants and bridges next week if Iran does not negotiate seriously (Source: @lelotsenzura/93604).
The US raised travel warnings to level 4 for Yemen, Lebanon, Iraq, and Iran, urging citizens to leave immediately (Source: @New_security8200/202635).
IDF eliminated three armed Hezbollah terrorists in Beit Yahoun in the southern Lebanon security zone (Source: @idf_telegram/24649).
Hezbollah is secretly preparing logistics and supplies along front lines awaiting 'zero hour' set by Iranian Revolutionary Guards (Source: @pkpoi/143309).
An Israeli soldier was sentenced to five years prison for espionage tasks for Iran via Telegram (Source: @manniefabian/58789).
IDF forces responded to stone-throwing terrorists near Maale Levona in Samaria; one civilian wounded, two vehicles damaged (Source: @idf_telegram/24627).

sections.executive_summary: The United States launched a new wave of airstrikes against Iran, with explosions reported in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Shiraz, and Kermanshah. President Trump threatened further strikes on Iranian power plants and bridges next week without a negotiated agreement. Israel and Hezbollah remain on heightened operational alert along the Lebanon front and in the West Bank.

points: Four locations around the southwestern city of Ahvaz came under US airstrikes, with a fourth blast reported in Ahvaz and multiple blasts in Khuzestan Province (Source: @presstv/198902, @shin_persian/7928, @shin_persian/7931).
Explosions were reported in the port city of Bandar Abbas and in Shiraz in the depth of the country during a new US attack wave (Source: @N12chat/217640, @New_security8200/202628, @kianmeli1/89179).
Initial reports indicated jet activity over Kermanshah Province and two explosions heard in Konarak with US fighter jet sounds (Source: @shin_persian/7930, @SharghDaily/172239).
Trump claimed a seven-hour heavy bombardment of IRGC and army barracks in southern Iran and depth of soil caused heavy human casualties (Source: @mamlekate/103899).
The US President sought to distance himself from a February strike on a school in Minab, Iran, that killed 168 children and staff (Source: @presstv/198889).
A Pakistani report said Russia sent its Tu-214PU command and control aircraft to Tehran amid US-Iran tension (Source: @pkpoi/143311).
An Iranian source claimed Trump planned air strikes and ground invasion of Iran with Arab regime support; Iran prepared and warned Gulf regimes would not survive (Source: @pkpoi/143307).

sections.threat_assessment: US airstrikes across Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Shiraz, and Kermanshah indicate broad aerial campaign against Iranian military infrastructure with stated intent to hit power plants and bridges. Iran-aligned Hezbollah is prepositioning for escalation in southern Lebanon, raising immediate threat to IDF and Israeli border civilians. Bahrain sirens and IRGC naval interdiction of UAE vessels show Gulf maritime and homeland exposure. An Israeli soldier's Iran espionage conviction reveals ongoing covert penetration attempts.
sections.regional_response: The US issued level 4 evacuation orders for Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, and Yemen, signaling expectation of widening conflict. Russia reportedly deployed a Tu-214PU command aircraft to Tehran, suggesting strategic support to Iranian leadership. Hezbollah's logistics buildup and Bahrain's civil defense activation reflect regional actors bracing for spillover. UAE ADNOC vessel deflection by IRGC navy shows Tehran enforcing Strait-adjacent control despite Trump's Hormuz-open stance.
sections.intelligence_notes: Open-source Telegram channels show fragmented but consistent reports of multi-city US strikes in Iran and Hezbollah readiness tied to Iranian Revolutionary Guards direction. Israeli IDF channels confirm targeted killings in Lebanon and Gaza and domestic counter-espionage success. Gulf messaging via sirens and US travel advisories are leading indicators of anticipated escalation. Analysts should treat Pakistani/Russian aircraft claim as unconfirmed secondary reporting.
